# Third-party assets (vendored, no build step)

| Folder | What | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `font-manrope/` | Manrope 400-800 (UI and display font), `manrope-latin-*.woff2` | SIL OFL 1.1 (`font-manrope/OFL.txt`) |
| `lucide/` | Lucide line icons (SVG). `js/icons.js` inlines the ones the UI uses | ISC (`lucide/LICENSE`) |
| `fluent3d/` | Microsoft Fluent Emoji 3D pictures (PNG) | MIT (`fluent3d/LICENSE`) |

Files were downloaded from the upstream repositories (google/fonts, lucide-icons/lucide, microsoft/fluentui-emoji).
